Hi everyone,

The next London SynBio Network event will be on Thursday the 16th of April. As usual, we will have 2x20 mins talks, followed by networking over drinks and snacks:

🦠 Removing Host-Induced Bias in Directed Evolution with a Cell-Free, Ultra-High Throughput Screening Platform.
Lise Boursinhac (Hollfelder Lab | University of Cambridge)

🧬 Deciphering Human Gene Biochemistry at Scale Using Synthetic, Homology-Free DNA
Josh Mayne (Goldrick and Ceroni Labs | UCL and Imperial College London)

📍 Location and time: Thursday the 16th of April at 18:00, G06 (Sir Ambrose Fleming LT) in the Roberts building, Roberts Engineering Building, University College London, London WC1E 7JE (see this link to see how to get there). The event has step-free access and is open to anyone, but please register so reception has your details.

➡️ Register at: https://events.humanitix.com/london-synbio-network-14

🧬 London SynBio Network is organised by Early Career Researchers and hosts monthly meetups to bring Synbio folks from academia and industry together, providing an informal space to share ideas and ask for advice.
